parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. For more information, see [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: en, zh, and ja. The default value is en.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.
